work: Sanzo Wada, A Dictionary of Color Combinations (published by Seigensha)
note: The book records colours as CMYK only. Hex values here are produced the same way that site produces them: chroma-js's naive CMYK->RGB, i.e. channel = round(255 * (1 - ink) * (1 - k)). They are screen approximations of printed inks, not colorimetric conversions.
contrast_note: WCAG ratios against white and black, for picking text vs surface roles. Body text needs 4.5:1, large text 3:1. Many of these colours are vivid and only work as surfaces.
